system.description:
Beginning at 17th Level, your style is so unique and graceful that your enemies speak of you as if you were the originator of the different stances and styles you’ve blended. When you would cast a Taijutsu that requires a Taijutsu stance, you may spend 2 martial die, until the end of the current turn, attacks you make or saving throws you force a creature to make

ignores bonuses to AC as a result of jutsu if the Taijutsu you cast required an attack, and forces a hostile creature to remake a successful save if the Taijutsu cast forced a saving throw.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
